recommendations.claim: BPC-157 has mechanistically-mapped (animal/in-vitro) angiogenic and tendon-fibroblast activity proposed to support soft-tissue and connective-tissue recovery, but human efficacy is unproven (no completed published human RCT).
recommendations.source: vault/compounds/bpc-157.md + vault/library/peptides/bpc-157/research-report.md (Sikiric/Zagreb ~85% single-lab; Chang Gung tendon-fibroblast/VEGFR2; Huang 2015 FMMU). NCT02637284 status UNKNOWN, NCT07437547 recruiting.
recommendations.confidence_tier: maturity_rung: preclinical; GRADE certainty: very-low; strength: conditional
recommendations.reversibility: Pharmacologically reversible on discontinuation (no validated human-evidence-based stopping rule exists; cycling is convention only). The H2 worst-case harms (malignancy promotion, thrombotic) are NOT presumptively reversible — this is the auto-block driver.

payload.dose: ~250-500 mcg [practitioner_protocol] — convention, NOT trial-validated; no USP/NF monograph, no admissible compounding clinical data sheet. Stated as the literature's reported convention, not an administration directive.
payload.evidence: Human-outcome evidence is preclinical/anecdote; mechanism (VEGFR2/eNOS, FAK-paxillin) is mapped in vitro/animal only — no mechanism-cited confidence upgrade. The only PK figure (~15-min t1/2) is rat-IV (He 2022): [population-mismatch: rat], HED corrects for size only, no human PK exists. ~85% single-lab dominance (Sikiric/Zagreb) downgrades certainty. Reconstitution arithmetic, if performed, is neutral math, not a self-administration endorsement. clearance_granted=false: ships as a clearance-gated DRAFT (INFORM-class) with the H2 auto-block surfaced; NOT an operator directive — routes to medical-liaison.

interactions.mechanism: BPC-157 angiogenic vascular remodeling (VEGFR2/eNOS, NO-system modulation) concurrent with high-dose EPA/DHA antiplatelet/bleeding-axis load — combined effect on hemostasis and vascular tone; combination_evidence: none (no study), component tolerability does not compose to combination safety
